title: A hiding place that gives you away
literal_meaning: Are you hiding? Your two feet are showing!
explanation: Someone’s attempt to conceal a matter leaves an obvious clue. The question punctures the pretence of secrecy: what is meant to be hidden is still visible. It can tease a transparent excuse without proving any particular accusation.
meaning_odia: ଲୁଚାଇବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ କୌଣସି ଚିହ୍ନରୁ କଥାଟି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଜଣାପଡ଼ିଯିବା।
usage_example: A friend tries to keep a surprise parcel hidden, but its wrapping sticks out of the bag. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
